second_live_canary.reason: MDC-1.0 name/city field-order defect; fixed by MDC-1.1. Provider aggregate count was also absent.

productive_fallbacks: Continue EXACT_CURRENT_REFRESH only on populated unprocessed staging identities.
Run ECV over exact-detail identities needing live verification when work packets are available.
Run SMC/SRR-1.1 review on pre-authority mappings without allocating H-IDs.
Run source-lineage/recovery/QA work if provider-safe re-entry is not yet appropriate.
required_inputs: HSLCA-R1.0 / MDC-1.1 / PCF-1.0 / MDM / CMI / CWP / ECV / SMC / SRR-1.1 contracts
resume_instructions: Re-read GitHub main and compare parent_git_sha; if it moved, reconstruct ancestry before work.
Reconstruct E4/V13 authority or its later fully synchronized verified successor before any canonical mutation.
Respect provider-safe re-entry. Run one fresh current-locale HSLCA-R1.0 capture using MDC-1.1 identity semantics; do not hammer the provider immediately after a recent full crawl.
If an aggregate provider count is present, use the normal MDM path.

If the provider count remains absent and REPORTED_RECORDS_UNRESOLVED is the sole capture violation, run PCF-1.0 only when all pages were captured inside the same current capture window, partition cardinality is stable and every PCF gate passes.
Execute CMI anti-join -> CWP -> ECV -> SMC -> SRR-1.1 entirely pre-authority.
Acquire discover.swiss dsod-hs when the subscription credential becomes available and execute SSR-1.0.
Never reserve H-IDs from staging; NEW_CANONICAL remains authority work only.
done_when: One coherent target source universe is captured and source-scope reconciled EXACT or evidence-backed EXPLAINED.
Every frozen source record has exactly one terminal mapping with unmapped=0 and RECONCILE_REQUIRED=0.
DB, HOTELS_MASTER, Intelligence, Operational Graph, observability and recovery reconcile exactly in a bounded authoritative WOP wave before CRM_UNIVERSE_COMPLETE becomes true.
